title: Your Environment Shapes You | A Discipline Short Film
lines: He couldn't change, until he changed his surroundings.
New circle. New routine. New standard.
You become the average of the people and habits you surround yourself with.
If your circle isn't growing, you're not growing either.
Protect your focus like it's your most valuable asset.
Cut what drains you. Keep what builds you.
Design a life that makes discipline easy.
